summary: Franklin BSP Real Estate Debt, Inc. filed a routine Form 8-K under Item 8.01 to report payment of its September 2026 distributions on October 14, 2026, to holders of record as of September 29, 2026. Gross distributions were $0.1900 per share across Class G, G-D, G-S, E, and I common stock; net distributions after servicing fees were $0.1854 for Class G-D and $0.1739 for Class G-S, while Class G, E, and I received the full $0.1900. Payments were cash or reinvested via the distribution reinvestment plan; no special-situation event, advisor, or deal terms are present.
